select u.user_id, d.dept_id, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber AS phonenumber,u.pwd_update_time, u.tel_phone, u.sex, u.status, u.user_source, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time,u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, u.login_fail_num, u.enterprise_id, u.tenant_id, u.is_tenant_admin,u.tower_user_source,u.grade,u.emp_no,u.sort_no,u.source, u.white_ip_flag, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_name, d.dept_level, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, d.ancestors, st.tenant_name, d.INDUSTRY_CODE trade_info,st.province_id,st.city_id,d.INDUSTRY_CODE, d.app_ver_code, ic.industry_name, vfc.dispatch_desk_num, vfc.mobile_terminal_num from sys_user u LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM cte WHERE n < 50 ) SELECT u_inner.user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', n), ',', -1) AS split_dept_id FROM sys_user u_inner JOIN cte ON cte.n <= ( LENGTH(u_inner.DEPT_ID) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', '')) + 1 ) WHERE u_inner.del_flag = '0' ) u_split ON u.user_id = u_split.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u_split.split_dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info st ON u.tenant_id = st.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON ic.industry_code = d.INDUSTRY_CODE AND ic.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_fusion_communication_t vfc ON u.USER_ID = vfc.user_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0'
AND (u.user_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}),'%') or u.phonenumber like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}),'%') or u.nick_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}),'%'))
AND u.status = #{status}
AND u.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
AND u.create_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s %T')
${dataScope} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
